title: Copper Mountain Ski Day Adventure
includes: Single-day Copper Mountain Lift Ticket (already have one? please call 720-583-0654 for adjustments)
Priority access to performance rentals (skis/snowboard, poles, boots, helmet, goggles)
Children under 8 years old - call local operator for exceptions / private options (not included)
We do NOT provide additional clothing for our guests. Please dress accordingly (not included)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
You won’t find a more affordable way to ski, combining wholesale pricing with premium transportation and on-mountain concierge service.

Escape Denver for a full day at Copper Mountain. Ski or ride naturally divided terrain, with access to 23 chair lifts and 162 trails. Don't feel like skiing? Grab a hot drink and watch the Olympians train, stroll through one of three villages for shopping, peep the snow sculptures, or relax at the spa. 

After an exhilarating day, enjoy après in Center Village before relaxing on your ride back to Denver. The perfect all-in-one winter experience.
